# School Assurance Letter Template

Dear `[School Contact]`,

Thank you for considering Après School as a partner for `[Provision Type]` at `[School Name]`.

Après School operates with a safeguarding-first approach and maintains internal processes for safer recruitment, staff records, policy acknowledgement, scheduling, incident reporting and school-facing assurance.

For your records, we can provide the following where appropriate:

- Public policy summaries and approved policy documents.
- Confirmation of safer recruitment processes.
- Insurance documentation.
- Staff role and training expectations.
- Site setup and collection procedure information.
- Booking and parent communication guidance.

Provision is planned around your school timetable, site routines, facilities and parent community. Any site-specific requirements should be agreed before launch and reviewed as provision develops.

Kind regards,

Après School
